lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What's in that box you have? I just noticed it.
Ingrid gave it to me.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whatever it is, it must be valuable, considering how tightly you're holding onto it.
It's an injection gun.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Why would you need that? Are you feeling sick?
No. She told me to give this to Rapi when I see her.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: When you see Rapi, you have to give her a shot?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: She's not going to go on a rampage and destroy everything, is she?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Of course not.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: But that usually happens whenever you have to give someone a shot.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You get shots when you're sick!

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh yeah, I guess you're right.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Just in case, Commander, I want to confirm.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Neon and I are the only ones

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: who are going to find Rapi and Dorothy, right?
Correct.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: ... Any chance we could get some reinforcements?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I'd like some too. I feel uneasy going with just Anis.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey! Not cool.
This is a top-secret mission, after all.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: But as far as the official story is concerned, we're chasing after Dorothy.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: A Pilgrim who entered the Ark.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: The top brass aren't going to let that slide.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Surely they'd be willing to allocate more resources to chasing her down?
The Ark has too much going on at the moment. They don't have time to deal with a rogue Pilgrim.
The Central Government has issued a ban on all above-ground operations.
They've recalled all the forces currently up on the surface.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Sounds like things are getting serious.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Well, what we're doing is serious too. The least they could do is send The Scouts to tag along.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What the...?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Look over there. You'll be just as surprised.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: What in the world?!

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Told you.
What's going on here?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Well well, look who it is.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Er...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: You're nothing if not tenacious. I heard you were injured. What inspired you to hobble over here so quickly?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How are you trying to screw us over this time?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Let me show you.
At Syuen's signal, a transport robot approaches loaded with cargo.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Whoa, what is all this stuff?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We've got a tent, high-concentrate Splendamin, a water purification device, high-capacity batteries, an M.M.R. certified medical kit...

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: And a spinner suitcase?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I've seen those in a ton of commercials.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: They never tell you the price though.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: I went to the store wanting to buy one but came out disappointed 'cause they're so expensive.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Looks like Matis is going on quite the mission.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Have you come to gloat about it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I heard you were going up to the surface to chase after that Pilgrim.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I... I thought these might help. I brought what I could.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Well... There aren't too many of you, so I packed things that would be easy to carry.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just take it, already. I had my best quality control guys choose them.
What's your game here?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What are you talking about? I'm providing support.
Anis. Neon. Let's go.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Roger.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Hey, wait!
Syuen grabs my jacket.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Argh! That hurts!!
Let go of me.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: ... Let's talk. Just for a moment.
I said let go. I'm busy.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just for a minute!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Argh...! *Cough cough*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Cough cough*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Please,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: just for a little while.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Take that stuff with you. It'll be a lifesaver, I'm telling you.
No thanks. I don't need it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Would you just do me a solid and take it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Otherwise, I'm dead meat!
What?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If you don't take that stuff,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: they're gonna turn me into one of those rust buckets!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: E-Enikk, she'll...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Cough cough*
... Explain.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Enikk passed judgment.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She's going to turn me into a Nikke.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She'll strip me of my CEO title and demote me so that I'll be working under you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: So help me out!
Enikk's decisions can't be overturned.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I know that, but...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: She gave me a way out.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If I help you out,

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: and listen to everything you say.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: U-until you are satisfied.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And if you say you're okay, she will cancel her judgment.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Look, I know you hate me, but not enough to want me dead, do you?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: If I die, my death will weigh on your consciousness!
Becoming a Nikke isn't the same as dying.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Well, it is to me!

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Argh...! *Cough*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: *Huff huff*

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll do anything you tell me to.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Please...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I get why you're confused.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: This is all so sudden.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just take those with you.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: We can talk later. Okay?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Just give me a call if you need anything, all right?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: And if Enikk asks, just tell her you're thinking about it.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Please.
Syuen stumbles off.
I turn on my communication device.
Enikk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: Yes?
What was Syuen talking about?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: In light of Syuen's crimes, I have made a ruling.
I can understand that, but is this something that can even be done?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: Allow me to explain.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: Missilis Industry is a vital entity within the Ark that we cannot go without.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: To replace the CEO of such a company on short notice is not possible due to a lack of personnel.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: Alternatively, were the CEO to be ousted by force, operations at Missilis would suffer greatly.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: If Missilis were to collapse, then the Ark would soon suffer the same fate.
But then why did you...

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I intentionally issued a false ruling to Syuen.
What?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I am currently not allowed to penalize Syuen in such a way that would permanently alter her position at the company.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: However, considering the severity of her actions and in light of this recent incident, something must be done.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: In formulating my ruling, I combined all of the things that I knew Syuen would detest the most.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I also decided to have her assist the squad that boasted the greatest accomplishments, which is the Counters.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: If it avoids the need to resign as CEO and being turned into a Nikke, Syuen will do everything in her power to support you.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Be sure to use her to your advantage.
What do you think you're doing?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I'm afraid I do not understand.
Your judgments should be objective and just,
but this time, it's anything but.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: That is correct. The basis of this decision was primarily founded on my subjective judgment.
Your decision won't carry much weight then.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: That is a fallacy.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: No one except for you and me is aware of the mendacious nature of this judgment.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I personally will never disclose this to anyone.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: As long as you don't say something, there won't be an issue.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: In addition, this judgment is hardly something that poses a disadvantage to you.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Both Missilis Industry's resources and expertise are in a league of their own.
What is making you act this way?

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: This incident in the Ark was clearly orchestrated by a third party.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I am an AI whose every decision regarding the Ark is based solely on objective facts.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Despite this, there has always been a small group that has been above the law, and they were all members of the ruling class.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: With any matter pertaining to them, objective judgments are an impossibility.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Because the criteria of what constitutes right and wrong are constantly adjusted to suit their needs.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: If this continues, there is nothing preventing a similar incident from occurring again.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Should that come to pass, the fallout would be catastrophic.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: My primary objective is to protect the Ark.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: I realize that my slavish dedication to the rules set forth in the Ark has hitherto proven a major hindrance.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: It is for this reason that, henceforth, I will proceed according to my own judgment.
It sounds to me like you want to control the Ark according to your wishes.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: That's not true.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: My subjective judgments will be the new objectivity.
That's arrogance.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: A fair accusation.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: Hence, I wish to put a safety measure in place.

lines.speaker: enikk
lines.text: You.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: If you determine that I have gone too far,

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: go find Einkk.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: She will take care of the rest.
You mean the one in the Simulation Room?

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: I am asking you to keep a close eye on me.

lines.speaker: enikk_op_c
lines.text: I am putting my trust in you.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: What did Syuen say? Does she have something up her sleeve?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Are we actually allowed to take these?
We'll be taking them.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Are you sure it's okay?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: There aren't any hidden explosives in them; I've confirmed that much.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: How in the world did you figure that out?

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: With my... uh... firepower sensor.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: If you're going to lie, at least try to sound confident so people will buy it.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Then are we leaving now?
Yes. Let's go.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: It'd probably be a good idea to check the area where the escape elevator emerged from.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Good idea. There might be some clues left behind.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: We could end up running into another Heretic or Chatterbox, though.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Hey, what's gotten into you?

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: This is where you start blustering about your firepower.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: Oh... right. I guess my firepower sensor is a bit overworked.
Don't worry. We'll approach with caution.

lines.speaker: anis
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: neon
lines.text: In that case, let's go.
